play_session_end_state_kind_check.name: play_session_end_state_kind_check
play_session_end_state_kind_check.value: "play_session"."end_state" IS NULL OR ("play_session"."kind" = 'cash' AND "play_session"."end_state" IN ('held', 'cashed_out', 'finished')) OR ("play_session"."kind" = 'tournament' AND "play_session"."end_state" IN ('bagged', 'busted', 'finished'))

play_session_end_stack_required_check.name: play_session_end_stack_required_check
play_session_end_stack_required_check.value: "play_session"."end_stack" IS NOT NULL OR NOT ("play_session"."end_state" IN ('bagged', 'held'))
